Export Yamlet

Source: R/io_yamlet.R
io_yamlet.yamlet.Rd

Exports yamlet. The archetype method for io_yamlet. Similar to write_yamlet but returns (description of) con.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'yamlet'
io_yamlet(
  x,
  con = stdout(),
  eol = "\n",
  useBytes = FALSE,
  default_keys = getOption("yamlet_default_keys", list("label", "guide")),
  fileEncoding = getOption("encoding"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

yamlet

con

passed to writeLines

eol

end-of-line; passed to writeLines as sep

useBytes

passed to writeLines

default_keys

character: default keys for the first n anonymous members of each element

fileEncoding

if con is character, passed to file as encoding

...

passed to as.character.yamlet

Value

invisible description of con: i.e., a file path

See also

Other io: io_csv(), io_csv.character(), io_csv.data.frame(), io_res(), io_res.character(), io_res.decorated(), io_table(), io_table.character(), io_table.data.frame(), io_yamlet(), io_yamlet.character(), io_yamlet.data.frame()

Examples

library(csv)
file <- system.file(package = 'yamlet', 'extdata','quinidine.csv')
x <- decorate(file)
out <- file.path(tempdir(), 'out.yamlet')
io_yamlet(as_yamlet(x), out)
io_yamlet(out)
#> - Subject
#>  - label: patient identifier
#> - time
#>  - label: time since start of study
#>  - guide: h
#> - conc
#>  - label: quinidine serum concentration
#>  - guide: mg/L
#> - dose
#>  - label: quinidine administered dose
#>  - guide: mg
#> - interval
#>  - label: inter-dose interval
#>  - guide: h
#> - Age
#>  - label: baseline subject age
#>  - guide: year
#> - Height
#>  - label: baseline subject height
#>  - guide: in
#> - Weight
#>  - label: subject body weight
#>  - guide: kg
#> - Race
#>  - label: subject race
#>  - guide: Caucasian, Latin, Black
#> - Smoke
#>  - label: smoking status
#>  - guide: 'no', 'yes'
#> - Ethanol
#>  - label: ethanol abuse status
#>  - guide: none, current, former
#> - Heart
#>  - label: congestive heart failure
#>  - guide: No/Mild, Moderate, Severe
#> - Creatinine
#>  - label: creatinine clearance
#>  - guide
#>   - < 50 mg/min: < 50
#>   - '>= 50 mg/min': '>= 50'
#> - glyco
#>  - label: alpha-1 acid glycoprotein concentration
#>  - guide: mg/dL
